cross_verification.note_en: The official Ethiopian e-Visa portal (evisa.gov.et) is a JavaScript-rendered single-page application; repeated direct fetches (English and French locale pages, tourist-info page, root page) returned only the page <title> tag with no readable body text, so none of its stated photo requirements could be confirmed first-hand. Many third-party visa-photo vendor sites (visafoto.com, photogov.com, mybiometricphotos.com, ethiopia-e-visa.com) converge on figures like 35×45mm / white background / 600dpi / 2MB JPEG, but per the truthfulness gate these are excluded because they are not the primary official source and their claims could not be cross-checked against actual evisa.gov.et page content. All fields left unverified rather than adopting aggregator consensus.
